data.name: Fayyaz
data.gender_notes: Fayyaz is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Means 'conqueror' or 'triumphant' in Arabic. This name is derived from the Arabic root 'fayyadah' which means to conquer or to triumph. The name Fayyaz carries the meaning “Conqueror, Triumphant” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu. Parents who choose Fayyaz usually hope their child will grow to embody conqueror, triumphant and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes inner strength, courage, and determination to overcome challenges in life.
data.etymology: Fayyaz belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Conqueror, Triumphant.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Fayyaz total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

in_english.name: Fayyaz
in_english.long_meaning: Fayyaz is an Arabic name derived from the root F-Y-Y, meaning to split, divide, or separate. In Islamic tradition, the name Fayyaz connotes nobility, radiance, luminosity, brightness, and shining. It is mentioned in the Quran in Surah Al-An'am, verse 1. In Arabic, the name Fayyaz refers to the one who brings light into darkness, symbolizing hope, guidance, and spiritual illumination.
